description: Election Commission - Appoint the Officer for Administrative District as the Returning Officer for Electing Members to the Local Authority Elections
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes for a local authority (Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha), including nomination procedures, candidate numbers, women representation requirements, and election deposits. It is a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance published by the Election Commission, making it clearly about election administration rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or any other specialized category.
